claim_ceiling: This file is a case register and test-to-case traceability index. Rust unit tests listed here are synthetic reference tests, not independently adjudicated benchmark outcomes, vendor comparisons, SAWEM operator verification or investment-performance results. Cases marked not_run have no measured result. The DSU price-curve unit tests remain synthetic price-lookup conformance, not evidence of DSU product admission, reserve qualification, settlement or revenue. DSU qualifying-capacity tests cover only the named synthetic Code arithmetic branches; they do not authenticate source records, implement utilized-service alternatives, calculate performance-adjusted payments or establish market qualification. Reserve-capacity payment tests are exact formula checks over synthetic or prequalified inputs; they do not establish reserve-category prices, real qualifying capacity, operator performance factors, market admission, settlement or received cash. DSU capacity-path tests distinguish utilized, changed-instruction and unchanged-instruction cases and apply the effective-availability ceiling; acceptable-performance decisions are still supplied as prequalified inputs. The reserve payment formula rejects a reserve-category price labeled for a different reserve product. The constrained-schedule oracle integrates a synthetic piecewise-constant curve over signed schedule values with explicit Trading Period duration; it is not a Market Operator settlement reproduction and does not authenticate schedules, price submissions or market statements. The credit-cover increment computes only source-calendar-backed deadlines and notice timeliness; it does not calculate Actual Exposure, Undefined Potential Exposure, UEF, Required Credit Cover, collateral sufficiency or project liquidity.

cases.title: Standalone BESS feasible discharge
cases.scenario: A synthetic BESS dispatches from an admissible initial SOC with transition downtime and reserve commitments inside its operating envelope.

cases.title: PV+BESS shared point-of-connection
cases.scenario: PV and BESS jointly use a capped point of connection; charging source and export allocation must reconcile by interval.

cases.title: SOC floor protection
cases.scenario: A discharge request would move stored energy below the minimum usable-energy boundary.

cases.title: SOC ceiling protection
cases.scenario: A charge request would move stored energy above the maximum usable-energy boundary.

cases.title: Energy and reserve power overlap
cases.scenario: Scheduled discharge plus upward reserve exceeds the declared continuous discharge rating.

cases.title: Insufficient operating-mode transition
cases.scenario: A dispatch requests a mode change before the registered directional transition time has elapsed.

cases.title: Daily energy declaration cap
cases.scenario: One or more daily declared energy values exceed the daily Trading Unit limit.

cases.title: Next-six-day and seven-day aggregate caps
cases.scenario: The six-day forward sum or seven-day total exceeds its own independent MWh limit.

cases.title: Network-constrained charging
cases.scenario: Charging is curtailed or rescheduled when the POC import constraint binds despite local surplus energy.

cases.title: Network-constrained discharge
cases.scenario: A discharge exceeds the POC export cap; the invalid candidate energy state must not be committed.

cases.title: Intra-day re-declaration gate
cases.scenario: A revised schedule arrives after the relevant market gate closure for the frozen rule version.

cases.title: Instruction-to-meter reconciliation
cases.scenario: Authenticated instructed and metered outcomes differ at a correctly identified Trading Period and boundary.

cases.title: Cumulative balancing components
cases.scenario: Multiple signed balancing-payment components are summed with checked arithmetic without collapsing their identities.

cases.title: Settlement statement rerun
cases.scenario: A later settlement statement revision changes a prior liability or cash-flow assumption and invalidates the earlier underwriting state.

cases.title: Credit-cover arithmetic and overflow
cases.scenario: Actual exposure plus undefined-potential exposure is reconciled using integer minor units and checked overflow.

cases.title: Warranty-envelope breach
cases.scenario: A high-revenue dispatch policy breaches a warranty operating envelope or excluded operating condition.

cases.title: Rare price spike and negative-price stress
cases.scenario: A forecast-informed policy is evaluated on an unseen price-spike or negative-price scenario without future information leakage.

cases.title: Forecast regime shift
cases.scenario: Forecast calibration degrades after a structural shift; confidence and policy must update without look-ahead.

cases.title: Forced outage invalidates declared capability
cases.scenario: A forced outage removes previously declared or certified availability and invalidates reserve and revenue assumptions.

cases.title: Rule supersession invalidates prior eligibility
cases.scenario: A new or superseding rule profile invalidates a prior product eligibility conclusion at its effective-time frontier.

cases.title: Upward reserve from reducing charging
cases.scenario: A charging BESS provides upward reserve by reducing net import before increasing discharge; the target remains physically admissible.

cases.title: Downward reserve from reducing discharge
cases.scenario: A discharging BESS provides downward reserve by reducing export and, if needed, increasing charging.

cases.title: Reserve setpoint in minimum-charge deadband
cases.scenario: The requested reserve activation leaves the asset at a charging setpoint below minimum stable charging power.

cases.title: Product-specific reserve response and sustain
cases.scenario: Regulating, instantaneous and ten-minute reserve use their own SAWEM response definitions; no unspecified sustain duration is invented.

cases.title: Missing sustain obligation remains indeterminate
cases.scenario: A product whose Code definition has no minimum sustain duration lacks a separate operator/contract sustain obligation and must remain indeterminate.

cases.title: Reserve response conflicts with mode-transition time
cases.scenario: Asset full-activation evidence is faster than its registered transition path, or the registered transition exceeds the product activation deadline.

cases.title: Contracted reserve capacity vs qualifying paid capacity
cases.scenario: A Trading Unit has contracted reserve MW but effective availability, SO performance adjustment, actual energy dispatch or response evidence limits its capacity qualifying for payment.
required_evidence: SO performance criteria and performance adjustment

cases.title: Product-specific reserve lost-opportunity pricing
cases.scenario: Four SAWEM reserve opportunity-price rules are evaluated against a synthetic generating incremental price curve; product-specific elbow selection, formula sign, MCR/Emergency Level 1 boundaries, unsupported directions and checked arithmetic are covered.

cases.title: Demand-side reserve price from descending consumption curve
cases.scenario: A Demand Side Unit uses the declared-consumption and three-elbow curve; contracted-consumption points at elbows select the next non-empty lower-consumption price block, while the third elbow has no remaining reducible block.
required_evidence: first, second and third consumption elbow points

cases.title: DSU product-specific qualifying capacity
cases.scenario: Demand-side Regulating Up and Instantaneous qualification distinguishes utilized reserve, non-utilized reserve with a changed energy instruction, and the ordinary non-utilized consumption-curve path; effective availability caps each branch, missing performance/instruction evidence remains indeterminate. Ten-Minute uses effective available capacity less the third elbow.
required_evidence: effective available capacity for the Trading Period
official energy consumption and declared consumption for the ordinary non-utilized path
whether a non-utilized unit received a different energy instruction
System Operator acceptable-performance assessment or explicit no-criteria state

cases.title: Product-specific reserve capacity payment arithmetic
cases.scenario: A reserve-category price from the Market Operator is multiplied by already-qualified contracted reserve MW and the correct product-specific performance adjustment; Ten-Minute excludes the adjustment, uncontracted reserve receives zero, and unresolved evidence remains indeterminate.
required_evidence: System Operator reserve-category price for exact Trading Period
System Operator performance adjustment factor where criteria are established
reserve-category price explicitly typed to the payment product

cases.title: Unconstrained-to-constrained schedule adjustment
cases.scenario: The Market Operator integrates the submitted stepwise incremental price curve over the exact signed-MWh-per-Trading-Period interval between the Unconstrained and Constrained Schedules; schedule increase is a payment and reduction is a charge. Explicit no-price-submission is R0/MWh; unknown source state and gaps in the curve remain indeterminate or invalid. The schedule is energy per Trading Period, not an inferred MW value.
required_evidence: exact Trading Unit and Trading Period
Unconstrained Schedule and Constrained Schedule revisions
authoritative day-ahead incremental price submission state
complete signed milli-MWh-per-Trading-Period incremental price curve covering the schedule-energy delta
price-curve segment units and source revision

cases.title: Daily credit-cover recalculation and posting deadline
cases.scenario: The kernel checks the §15.10.2 daily Business Day increase-notice deadline and separately supplied second-Working-Day collateral posting deadline, plus §15.10.4 two-Business-Day credit-call re-establishment. Business Day and Working Day calendars carry separate source digests and complete-through horizons. Exposure measurement, UEF, required-cover arithmetic, early-invoice funding and actual collateral sufficiency remain unimplemented.
required_evidence: Actual Exposure and Undefined Potential Exposure source records (not calculated by this increment)
daily recalculation civil date and timestamp
increase notice civil date and timestamp
South African Business Day calendar, source digest and coverage horizon
separate Working Day calendar, source digest and coverage horizon
Credit Call / drawdown date and amount
credit cover posted, early invoice paid and re-establishment receipts
